description: Weekly dependency bumps of every platform, including the Swift packages of iosApp/project.yml (Renovate's xcodegen manager). The pins and the stability rule are those of .claude/skills/bump-versions/SKILL.md; docs/ci.md explains the setup.

packageRules.description: Every minor and patch of every platform in one pull request a week. group:monorepos is ignored above, since its groups would split this one; the families that must share a major are grouped below. :semanticPrefixFixDepsChoreOthers is ignored so every title starts with chore:.
A major gets a pull request of its own, so its breaking changes are read and fixed apart from the rest.
The react packages must share a version: their major moves in one pull request.
The tailwind packages must share a version: their major moves in one pull request.
The remotion packages must share a version: their major moves in one pull request.
Every uses: of claude-review must pin the same release (claude-review-refs.yml), so they move together, as soon as a release ships.
copied-code-check's uses: in duplication.yml is also what scripts/cpd.sh runs: a pull request of its own, as soon as a release ships.
@js-joda/core is the exact version kotlinx-datetime's JS target depends on (kotlin-js-store/yarn.lock): bumped by hand with kotlinx-datetime, never to npm's latest.
The CI runtimes (java-version, node-version, ruby-version) follow the project's toolchain, not the newest release: changed by hand when the build needs it.
kotlinx-datetime publishes -0.6.x-compat builds for libraries still on the old API: never ours.
androidx-lifecycle is shared with JetBrains' multiplatform lifecycle-viewmodel, which ships later: the JetBrains artifact decides when the shared version moves, so both groups have the release.
